task: prove the line in pictures; stageability in watercolor-and-ink

candidates.treatment: Slide 1 wide: both on sofa, she sends, small hopeful smile. Slide 2 mid: her head turned, the first side-eye, he is laughing at his own phone. Slide 3 close: full unblinking side-eye filling the frame, his oblivious profile soft-focus. Pivot slide returns wide: both under one blanket watching her reel together, his head tipped onto her shoulder.
candidates.anatomy_note: Phones held in simple closed grips, screens implied by glow, no rendered UI. Hands minimal in close slides where the face does the work.
candidates.style_note: Side-eye is an ink-line acting problem: pupil position + eyebrow, not face distortion. Keeps identity lock easy because head shape and features stay neutral.

candidates.treatment: Each slide splits her face and the unopened chat. Rejected instinct: rendered chat UI fights house style and risks unreadable micro-text.
